mapper.insert: INSERT INTO openbiz_thing_model (tenant_id, product_id, model_json, version, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{productId}, #{modelJson}, #{version}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, product_id, model_json, version, status, create_time, update_time FROM openbiz_thing_model WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT id, tenant_id, product_id, model_json, version, status, create_time, update_time FROM openbiz_thing_model WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
